blocks.text: Misaligned district seams catch a passing pet at their joins.
Location: The Last City of Many Forms
Appearance: Different district polygons interlock at mismatched contacts, stretching against one another near the lower body.
Care: Use injury supplies and the recovery time shown in Care.
Story connection: A civic repair route could reconnect two districts without erasing either.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Established Era Three location, possibly several places merged in memory.
